mapper.insert: insert into pw_async_task ( biz_key, task_type, payload, owner_user_id, status, retry_count, max_retry_count, next_retry_at, lease_until, last_error, priority ) values ( #{bizKey}, #{taskType}, #{payload}, #{ownerUserId}, 'PENDING', 0, #{maxRetryCount}, null, null, null, #{priority} ) on conflict (biz_key) do update set task_type = excluded.task_type, payload = excluded.payload, owner_user_id = excluded.owner_user_id, max_retry_count = excluded.max_retry_count, priority = greatest(pw_async_task.priority, excluded.priority), retry_count = case when then 0 else pw_async_task.retry_count end, next_retry_at = case when then null else pw_async_task.next_retry_at end, lease_until = case when then null else pw_async_task.lease_until end, last_error = case when then null else pw_async_task.last_error end, status = case when then 'PENDING' else pw_async_task.status end
mapper.select: select id, biz_key, task_type, payload, status, retry_count, max_retry_count, next_retry_at, lease_until, last_error, priority, created_at, updated_at from pw_async_task where (status = 'PENDING' and (next_retry_at is null or next_retry_at <= #{now})) or (status = 'PROCESSING' and lease_until is not null and lease_until <= #{now}) order by priority desc, created_at asc, id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update pw_async_task set status = 'PROCESSING', lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, last_error = null where id = #{id} and ( (status = 'PENDING' and (next_retry_at is null or next_retry_at <= #{now})) or (status = 'PROCESSING' and lease_until is not null and lease_until <= #{now}) )
update pw_async_task set status = 'COMPLETED', lease_until = null, next_retry_at = null, last_error = null where id = #{id} and status = 'PROCESSING' and lease_until = #{leaseUntil}
mapper.delete: with rows_to_delete as ( select id from pw_async_task where status = 'COMPLETED' and updated_at < #{before} order by updated_at asc, id asc limit #{limit} ) delete from pw_async_task using rows_to_delete where pw_async_task.id = rows_to_delete.id
